sws-overview-first-steps: A subject records one thing; its schema says which properties it has. Use "Create subject" above to add your first subject.
sws-main-page-text: This wiki records structured data with Semantic WikiSchema: each Subject describes one thing, such as a person or an artwork, with the properties its Schema defines. {{#create_subject: page=new}} == Getting started == * [[Special:UserLogin|Log in]], then create your first Subject with the button above. If no Schema fits yet, create one in the dialog the button opens. * The [[Special:SWS|Semantic WikiSchema overview]], with your Schemas and recent Subjects, is in the Semantic WikiSchema section of the Tools menu on every page. == Help and feedback == * In the [https://github.com/Klaus-Feldmann/SemanticWikiSchema/blob/master/docs/guide/getting-started.md Getting started guide], you create a Schema and a Subject, show the Subject on a page, and query your data. * The [https://github.com/Klaus-Feldmann/SemanticWikiSchema/blob/master/docs/glossary.md SWS glossary] explains Subjects, Schemas and other terms. * Questions and feedback go to the [https://github.com/Klaus-Feldmann/SemanticWikiSchema/issues fork issue tracker]. == For administrators == * Before adding data, choose whether this wiki is page-first or subject-first on the [{{fullurl:MediaWiki:SWS}} Semantic WikiSchema settings page]. * Replace this page with an introduction to your wiki.
